title: Plan-Change Tenure Reduction Schedule, Residential Electricity Supply
content:
**Rule.** On a Residential Electricity Supply plan change, when the agreement's service start date is 24 or more whole months before the change request the long plan tenure reduction of 0.30 cents per kWh applies, when it is 6 to 23 whole months before the mid plan tenure reduction of 0.15 cents per kWh applies, and when it is fewer than 6 whole months before none applies.

| Whole months from service start date to change request | Plan tenure reduction (cents per kWh) |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 0.30 |
| 6 to 23 | 0.15 |
| fewer than 6 | none |

**Counting.** The service start date is the switch meter read date recorded on the agreement; earlier plan changes and renewals do not reset it. A month is whole once the same day of the month is reached.

**Boundaries (hypothetical service start 2024-09-05).** A request on 2026-09-05 is 24 whole months, 0.30 cents; on 2026-09-04 it is 23, 0.15 cents; on 2025-03-05 it is 6, 0.15 cents; on 2025-03-04 it is 5, none.
